notes.title: Update V1.0.1.3
notes.notes:
Hi,

welcome to the new update v1.0.1.3!
Here are all the changes and fixes:

- We have limited all textures to 1024x1024 pixels. This means that significantly less graphics memory and less memory space should generally be used.
- The game now uses the crash handler built into the Unreal Engine. In this way, all errors and game crashes that arise can be analyzed and rectified more quickly
- The "FPS display" is currently being tested in the options. This still creates bugs.
- Some buttons now have a darker font, which should now be easier to read.


In addition, from today we will publish all patch notes in our [url=https://flo-server.eu/beitraege/]blog[/url] on our website. We plan to inform you about beta patch notes there too!

Do you have ideas and want to share them with us? Then you can do that here: [url=https://app.feedbacky.net/b/FLO-server]Feedbackly[/url]

Have a nice day

FLO server

notes.title: Update V1.0.1.2
notes.notes:
Hi,

In this update we paid more attention to controller vibration and bug fixes.
We plan to add controller support for the menus in the future. This week we also launched the public beta program for Das Balkonzimmer. You can always download the latest beta build from Steam and help us test and improve new features. Thanks for that!

But now first what was added in this update:

[list]
[*] The trees now (finally) have a collision and you can no longer walk through them
[*] The character has now added new voicelines for jumping and shooting
[*] A new crosshair is now also available
[*] Controller vibration was added, but still contains errors when switching on / off
[*] We added a collision for more objects
[/list]


Have a nice day,

FLO server

notes.title: Update V1.0.1.1
notes.notes:
Hi,

and welcome to the first update this year. We took our time and fixed some bugs and improved some game mechanics. Unfortunately we had problems with the water system, so we decided to deactivate it first.

However, the following has been changed:

[list]
[*] The game size was greatly reduced by compressing the game files
[*] The two buttons "Back to main menu" and "Back to game" in the options menu have been changed to a uniform "Back" button
[*] The main menu music is no longer interrupted when switching to another window
[*] The grass and flowers on the card are rendered longer and use less VRam overall on the graphics card
[*] The credits have been translated into all supported languages
[*] A new message box has been added for messages and information.
[*] The game now only pauses in single player when ESC is pressed.
[/list]

Have a nice day,

FLO server

notes.title: Update V1.0.1.0
notes.notes:
Hi,

we are happy to be able to publish an update again today! In the last week we noticed a few game errors that we have eliminated.

So let's start. What's new:

[h2] Landscape changes [/h2]

[list]
[*] New flowers
[*] New blueberries
[*] New blackberries
[*] A new lake *
[*] A new pile of wood
[*] More realistic looking mountains
[/list]

* You can currently walk across the lake. This bug is already being investigated.

[h2] bug fixes [/h2]

[list]
[*] The bug that player names are displayed incorrectly in multiplayer has been fixed
[*] The firing sound of the weapon is now more diverse
[*] Performance improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.0.0.9
notes.notes:
Hi,

We have mainly focused on the following points in this update:

[h3] New / optimized settings [/h3]

[list]
[*] Visibility can now be set
[*] Texture quality can now be adjusted
[*] Vsync can now be activated
[*] Fewer memory files are created
[/list]

[h3] Landscape and Foliage [/h3]

[list]
[*] 3 new types of grass
[*] better mountains
[*] better valleys
[/list]

[h3] Other fixes and features [/h3]

[list]
[*] The names of the players in multiplayer are now displayed
[*] The error that the "respawn screen" was displayed to everyone even though only one person died has been fixed
[/list]

If you have any further bugs or problems, don't hesitate to inform our support!

Have fun,

FLO server
